description.zh: 由容器管理的 openclaw gateway（自带最新版），主界面内嵌打开 Control UI；配置目录默认 ~/.openclaw
description.en: Container-managed openclaw gateway (bundled latest); the main window embeds its Control UI; the config dir defaults to ~/.openclaw

description.zh: 默认使用独立目录（容器独占，环境根目录下的 .openclaw 子目录）；若未手动改动且 ~/.openclaw 已有配置会自动沿用以免丢失；选系统通用目录则与终端共用同一套配置（~/.openclaw）
description.en: Uses a container-owned .openclaw subfolder of the env root by default; until you change it, an existing ~/.openclaw config is kept automatically so nothing is lost. Pick the system-common folder to share the CLI config store (~/.openclaw)
